memories.title: 预售详情流程查看按钮调整并统一审批记录显隐
memories.content: 全局 `zhi2-web-admin/src/components/OperationBtnGroup/index.vue` 将「流程查看」移至「返回」后并增 `data-testid="flow-view-btn"`。五个预售详情页（`presale/permit/components/detail.vue`、`presale/cashsale/components/CashsaleDetail.vue`、`permitExtend/detail.vue`、`permitCancel/detail.vue` 补 `:bus-code="appendixBusCode"`、`surveyChange/detail.vue`）去底部「审批记录」区块，改 `:show-audit="showFlowViewButton"`（查看态+已保存+`bizState!=='0'`），预售许可申请额外去

memories.title: 详情接口projectId空致楼盘表点击无响应
memories.content: 根因为 `/building/project/detail` 返回 `projectId` 为 `null`，旧代码 `openBuildingTable()` 中 `if(!this.form.projectId) return` 静默退出无报错。`zhi2-web-admin/src/views/projectManagement/customerProject/detail.vue` 的 `projectId` 改为回退链取值（`this.id`/`$route.params.tableId`/`$route.query.id`）。
